lore.origin: Mundane giant spiders nesting in Breley underworks; drawn to damp stone and trapped prey.
lore.description: Plate-sized bodies with mottled brown chitin; webs of sticky silk, not Ether-tainted.
lore.weaknesses: Fire destroys webs; bright lantern light reveals ceiling ambushes.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: Can climb difficult surfaces including ceilings without a check.

actions.name: Web
actions.text: Ranged 20 ft, +4 to hit. Hit: target is Webbed (speed 0). Escape: DC 11 STR or AGI check as action.
